name: What kind of preparation is needed before exterior painting?

mainEntity.name: What kind of preparation is needed before exterior painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper preparation is crucial for a long-lasting exterior paint job. Our team performs extensive preparation, which includes power washing to remove dirt and mildew, scraping away loose and peeling paint, and sanding uneven surfaces. We also fill minor cracks and holes, repair damaged stucco or wood, and caulk gaps around windows and doors to prevent moisture intrusion. Priming is applied to bare wood or patched areas to ensure optimal paint adhesion and a smooth, consistent finish. This thorough prep work is foundational to the paint's durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation includes power washing, scraping, sanding, filling cracks, repairing stucco/wood, caulking, and priming to ensure paint adhesion and durability.
